scope: Fresh normal Isaac, ordinary 1x1 coin rooms. Runtime inputs are public seed/key events and authored STB/XML/ANM2 resources. Native observations never enter WASM.

roomAdmission.stream: Descriptor spawnSeed initializes local xorshift11 (2,7,7); two initial bounded draws choose tinted-rock coordinates, then one f32 uniform per authored group, including empty groups
roomAdmission.weightedSelection: Source f32 cumulative weight must strictly exceed uniform times total weight; fallback is the first authored entry
roomAdmission.entitySeed: A new local xorshift35 (5,9,7), initialized by the group's current RNG11 state, advances once for entity spawnSeed; grids retain the group seed
roomAdmission.unsupported: Every selected entity/grid remains typed in Room.spawns; this coin runtime does not substitute unsupported pickup families, NPCs, shop prices or hazards

coins.subtype: An independent RNG35 initialized by entity spawnSeed rolls Random(20)==0 for nickel2, then Random(100)==0 for dime3; otherwise penny1. Concrete subtypes remain concrete.
coins.animation: Authored penny/nickel/dime clips: Appear33 full updates, Idle30 looping, Collect14 full updates. First room admission executes one update before incoming transition freezes animation.
coins.scheduling: Native active array in the observed coin rooms is Player then authored coins. EntityManager454df0 updates its entry-fenced array before calling contact manager4545d0; coin collection uses full phases after all actor movement/animation.

liveGate.cohorts: Two contrived public phase offsets plus at least two newly recorded OS-random hazard-free coin-room seeds; mandatory recorded22PFCSFS spike regression remains in the default CI cohort
assertions: pickup membership, subtype, spawnSeed, world position, collision radius
liveGate.failurePolicy: Every selected case executes. Functional failures are retained and determine a nonzero gate exit; unsupported hazards are not waived. Passing isolated coin cases do not turn the default regression cohort green.
